hard_negative_evidence_stops.condition: Any faithful non-oracle baseline ties or beats candidate on primary heldout metric under the frozen equivalence rule.
Any faithful non-oracle baseline is candidate-equivalent under the frozen equivalence rule.
Any graph_cache_family member ties, beats, or is candidate-equivalent to candidate.
Any required graph_cache_family member is missing, not callable, or not invoked.
query_capable_imitation_baseline ties, beats, or is candidate-equivalent to candidate on primary heldout or counterfactual metrics.
query_capable_imitation_baseline is missing, not callable, not given same query budget, or not invoked.
Equivalence rule is missing, not frozen before run, changed after run, selectively applied, or not recorded in provenance.
Ablation drop exists but any faithful baseline still solves the task or is candidate-equivalent.
ngram_trace_lookup or nearest_neighbor_trace_retrieval reaches candidate-equivalent performance.
Any leakage positive control fails to detect injected leakage.
Replay can pass from stored outputs, stored actions, trace-only comparison, or hashes.
Any declared heldout split, counterfactual pair, frozen seed, context ID, or episode ID is unused.
Candidate score improves but only through schema, config, ID, prompt, filename, path, or scoring-artifact leakage.
Candidate advantage depends on denying faithful baselines candidate-equivalent visible information or same query budget where applicable.
Primary metric is defined in terms of candidate output schema, candidate internals, or post-hoc candidate explanations.
Task becomes a same-family 002C patch, 002E variant, or local toy hardening route.

closure_rule: A hard negative-evidence stop must preserve the failed result and must not be repaired by threshold tuning, equivalence-margin changes, field hiding, rerun selection, or same-family patching inside the same task.
claim_ceiling: future stop-condition contract only; no future execution verdict is claimed by this task
